name: Conditional Probabilistic Directed Distance Field (CPDDF)
aliases: Conditional Probabilistic Directed Distance Field (CPDDF) with Shape VAE
definition: A method to encode a shape into a latent vector using a PointNet encoder and decode it into a depth field (CPDDF) using a modulated SIREN decoder, trained with a β-VAE loss.
summary: CPDDF is a generative method encoding 3D shapes into latent vectors to decode depth fields, enabling diverse shape generation from a Gaussian prior while maintaining rendering efficiency.
